svg.title: Pibbl particle and chart logo explorations

g.text: Six variations on Particle bloom · Vivid coral + Kelly green + soft violet
Particles become observations on a tiny scatter plot.
A loose particle trail resolves into a rising line chart.
Different dot sizes turn the bloom into a bubble chart.
A plotted line in the triangle pairs with a free particle bloom.
A dissolving curve settles into a grid of data points.
Particles follow radial guides around the curved bowl.
